outcomeEn: Infer a concern behind a qualified statement and adapt register for a formal reply.
contextFa: نینا و آیریس باید به پیام حامی برنامه مرکز محله پاسخ رسمی بدهند. تعریف اولیه پیام نباید درخواست اصلی را پنهان کند.

turns.textEn: The sponsor says they're pleased with the programme, although they would welcome clearer evidence of who it reaches.
That sounds supportive, but they may be questioning whether our impact figures are specific enough.
I don't want our reply to sound defensive or to promise data we haven't collected.
Let's acknowledge the gap, explain what the current figures do show and propose a realistic reporting date.

activities.instructionFa: گفت و گو را بخوان و هدف هر نوبت را پیدا کن.
کاربرد این عبارت ها را در موقعیت بررسی کن.

activities.promptFa: برداشت محتاطانه از پیام حامی چیست؟
optionsFa: حامی به طور قطعی حمایت را قطع می کند
حامی علاوه بر رضایت، شواهد دقیق تری می خواهد
حامی تایید کرده که همه گروه ها به یک اندازه پوشش گرفته اند
feedbackFa: پیام قطع حمایت را بیان نمی کند؛ چنین برداشتی بیش از شواهد است.
بخش although درخواست بهبود گزارش را پس از تعریف مطرح می کند.
هیچ داده ای درباره برابری پوشش در پیام نیست.

activities.promptFa: پاسخی رسمی در ۱۲۰ تا ۱۶۰ کلمه بنویس. فرض کن فقط تعداد حضورها را داری و دو هفته برای بررسی تفکیک داده لازم است؛ دسترسی قطعی به اطلاعات تازه را وعده نده.
activities.exampleAnswerEn: Thank you for your positive feedback and for identifying the value of clearer information about the programme's reach. Our current figures record total attendances; they do not yet show how participation is distributed across different groups. We recognise that this limits the conclusions that can be drawn about access and impact. Over the next two weeks, we will review the information currently available and identify which distinctions it can support reliably. We will then provide an update explaining both what can be established and where gaps remain. We cannot yet confirm that the existing records will support a full breakdown. Your view on the most useful reporting priorities would help us plan any further data collection and avoid presenting attendance totals as evidence of broader reach.
rubric: Commit to a review, not to unavailable results.
Preserve uncertainty and give a realistic date.

limitations: These are samples for calibrating demand and review effort; level alignment is provisional.
Open-response example answers are illustrations, not exact-match answer keys.
Prerequisite lessons are not supplied by this sample set.
Generated speech, perceptual QA and human/learner validation are still required before release.
